name: Tearout - call and response bass
description: A two-bar tearout bass figure built as a call and an answer: three spaced growl hits in bar one, the answer displaced later in bar two, a sub only under the first hit of each phrase and a stab in the last sixteenth of each bar. Renders MIDI into an existing clip; it does not load samples or design the growl.
notes: The gap between the call and the answer is the point: it gives the growl a tail to decay into and keeps the drop from turning into a wall. Pair it with tearout.growl for the sound and ableton.operator_bass for the patch. Sources: Melodigging tearout notes (https://www.melodigging.com/genre/tearout) and the style's call-and-response description.
